description:
The product side reconstructs causality exactly as the job side does. Replay::evaluate_product (113 lines, the largest method in the file) rebuilds triggers by scanning 'movement.position >= previous && movement.position < started' -- the same interval inference, over the pull session's movements.

The engine decides this too. pull.rs emits PRODUCT_EVALUATED with (key, request, outcome) and no cause, though it knows why it re-evaluated.

Precedent already exists in the same file: causal_product_events_enabled / emit_causal_products gate the causal product events on whether telemetry wants them. Extending that payload is the established mechanism, not a new one, and it keeps a telemetry-off run free.

Carry the trigger onto the evaluated event so ProductEvaluationCause is read rather than derived, then evaluate_product and record_product_movement collapse to tallies.
title: Carry the product evaluation trigger the pull engine already decides
